system.description:
FLOURISH KENSAI

Prerequisites Level 6

Action R; Trigger A creature misses you with a melee attack.

You may immediately change your active Combat Form. Any applicable bonuses apply immediately.

Automated: when a melee attack misses you, you are asked whether to change form: your reaction, no AP, and Combat Form is neither needed nor expended. The one-round wait between stances does not apply. Not automated: its Flourish trait is not counted against your turn's Flourish, as it comes on another creature's turn.
